## REPORTED 2026-09-02 (each verified ZERO hits across every prior report before inclusion):

1. PRIVATE SKILL CATALOG — /azure/foundry/agents/how-to/private-skill-catalog  (ms.date 2026-08-19, preview)
   Skill = "instructions, bundled scripts, and tool references."
   Registered as an ASSET in **AZURE API CENTER**, type Skill, with:
     title, summary, description, lifecycle stage, **Source URL** (the Git repo holding the source),
     and **Allowed tools** = "the APIs or MCP servers from your API inventory that the skill can access."
   >>> "The allowed tools list IS THE GOVERNANCE BOUNDARY for a skill." <<<
   - Git repo integration keeps the catalog in sync with source => a COMMIT changes what a shared
     org-wide agent capability does, with NO Azure control-plane event.
   - Governance > AI Assessment scores skills vs default/custom criteria (name, score range, pass
     threshold, weight) before promotion => an LLM-adjacent judgement standing in for a review gate.
   - Developer access = **Azure API Center Data Reader** (coarse, all-or-nothing per reader).
     Role assignments take UP TO 24 HOURS to propagate => revocation is not immediate.
   - Discovered in the Foundry portal under Build > Skills.
   => Zenity's Foundry collector MUST read Azure API Center or it understates agent reach.
      Same shape as the AgentCore skill catalog (reported 08-21) but boundary is EXTERNALIZED.

2. LONG-RUNNING + STEERABLE HOSTED AGENTS (preview) — packages `azure-ai-agentserver-*`
   /agents/concepts/long-running-agent-reference (ms.date 2026-08-10)
   /agents/concepts/long-running-agent-resilience
   /agents/how-to/steer-hosted-agent (ms.date 2026-08-05)
   plus how-to: deploy-resilient-agent, manage-task-state, recover-long-running-work,
   stream-with-reconnect, deploy-steerable-agent, add-human-in-the-loop.
   STEERING: `steerable_conversations=True` on ResponsesServerOptions, or `steerable=True` on
     @multi_turn_task. A 2nd input on a BUSY conversation QUEUES and the running handler
     COOPERATIVELY CANCELS, instead of `409 conversation_locked`. Follow-up sent as a new response
     with previous_response_id = the RUNNING response + same agent_session_id.
     Ordering guard is OPTIONAL: `if_last_input_id` ("the input-queue equivalent of an HTTP If-Match");
     mismatch => LastInputIdPreconditionFailed. Bounded queue => SteeringQueueFull.
     Context fields: ctx.is_steered_turn, ctx.pending_input_count, ctx.cancel.
     MS's own example: "Plan a trip to Rome" -> "Actually, Paris" MID-EXECUTION.
   DURABILITY: @task / @multi_turn_task. TaskContext.entry_mode = fresh | resumed | **recovered**.
     TaskStatus = Pending | InProgress | **Suspended** | Completed. Input PERSISTED BEFORE the handler
     runs, ~10 MiB limit (InputTooLarge). "Crash recovery re-enters the same attempt and DOESN'T
     CONSUME RETRY BUDGET" => unbounded re-entry without tripping RetryPolicy.
     ResponsesServerOptions: resilient_background (default False), steerable_conversations (False),
     default_fetch_history_count=100, shutdown_grace_period_seconds=10.
     ResponseContext: is_recovery, persisted_response, conversation_chain_metadata, ConversationChainId.
     STREAMING REGISTRY: use_in_memory_live() | use_in_memory_replay(ttl) |
     **use_file_backed_replay(storage_dir=...)** — the last PERSISTS TO DISK AND SURVIVES RESTART.
   => durable agent state (task inputs, persisted_response snapshots, chain metadata, on-disk replay
      buffers) OUTLIVES THE CONTAINER and is invisible to point-in-time inventory.

3. BRING YOUR OWN REGISTRY — /agents/how-to/private-registry-connections
   *** ms.date 2026-09-01 — the NEWEST Foundry page this scan ***
   Hosted agents deployed from container registries OUTSIDE AZURE: JFrog Artifactory (validated),
   self-hosted Docker Distribution (needs a CUSTOMER-BUILT auth adapter — "Foundry doesn't define a
   universal ... request and response contract").
   Auth = OIDC TOKEN EXCHANGE. Entra application supplies the AUDIENCE (no client secret needed);
   the **Foundry project MANAGED IDENTITY** is the exchanged subject; registry issues short-lived
   pull creds => NO STORED REGISTRY SECRET (also: no credential artifact to inventory).
   Materializes as a project connection: category `CustomKeys`, authType `CustomKeys`,
     metadata { type: "registry_connection", mode: "oauth_token_exchange" },
     keys { audience, tokenEndpoint, body.provider_name, body.* }.
   Agent definition: `registryConnectionId` + `docker.imagePassthrough: true`.
   API version on the connection resource: 2025-04-01-preview. Requires `Foundry Project Manager`.
   => THE IMAGE AN AGENT RUNS NEED NOT EXIST IN ANY AZURE RESOURCE. ACR enumeration is now blind.
   *** ALSO ON THIS PAGE — RBAC ROLE RENAME ***
     Azure AI User        -> Foundry User
     Azure AI Owner       -> Foundry Owner
     Azure AI Account Owner -> Foundry Account Owner
     Azure AI Project Manager -> Foundry Project Manager
   "The role IDs and core permissions are unchanged by the rename."
   => ANY Zenity rule/query matching Foundry roles BY DISPLAY NAME silently stops matching.

4. MICROSOFT FOUNDRY TOOLKIT FOR VS CODE — /how-to/develop/get-started-projects-visual-studio-code
   (ms.date 2026-08-20; also install-foundry-toolkit-visual-studio-code,
    set-up-foundry-project-visual-studio-code, foundry-skills-scenarios-example-prompts)
   "Foundry Toolkit is the NEW NAME FOR AI TOOLKIT. It also includes the capabilities previously
    provided by the SEPARATE Microsoft Foundry extension."  => two extension IDs collapse into one;
    identifier-based endpoint detection breaks.
   Tool Catalog discovers "Foundry tools, **Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers**, and toolboxes".
   Agent Builder configures instructions/models/variables/structured outputs/tools **WITHOUT creating
    an agent code project** => an agent can exist with NO FILE IN SOURCE CONTROL.
   Agent Inspector debugs local agents, streaming responses, tool calls, workflow execution.
   Local models via ONNX, **Ollama**, Foundry Local. Local GPU fine-tuning. NPU/GPU profiling.
   Deploys hosted agents to Foundry Agent Service FROM SOURCE CODE OR A CONTAINER IMAGE.
   Changelog lives at microsoft.github.io/foundry-toolkit/ (NOT on learn.microsoft.com).
